news.analysis: Maye struggled mightily in the first half, but turned things around in the second half on his way to three touchdowns, two through the air, one on the ground. It wasn't all pretty, but he made it work for fantasy managers, who are riding high on his hot streak.
news.contents: Drake Maye completed 16-of-20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns, also running eight times for five yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.title: Drake Maye puts up three touchdowns in win over Miami

news.analysis: Dobbins wasn't targeted and averaged 1.9 yards per carry. Meanwhile, Jonah Coleman had 15 touches for 104 total yards and scored the game-winning touchdown. Dobbins had scored in three straight games entering Sunday, but Coleman has led Denver's running backs in carries in both games since returning. The former is becoming touchdown-dependent.
news.contents: J.K. Dobbins rushed seven times for 13 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.

news.contents: Arizona Cardinals running back Bam Knight (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Dallas Cowboys, according to Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic. Knight suffered the injury late in the second quarter on a 10-yard reception that ended in a lost fumble. He finished with three carries for eight yards and one reception for 10 yards. news.contents: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) was seen getting some work in during Tuesday's unofficial practice, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. The Panthers are still deciding whether they will open Brooks' 21-day practice window this week to return from Injured Reserve, but it is a good sign that he was out on the practice field on Wednesday. news.analysis: Stowers was productive in just his second NFL game, finishing second on the team in receiving. The second-round pick out of Vanderbilt should continue to get a chance to show what he can do in what is shaping up as a lost season for the Eagles. He is worth monitoring in deeper leagues moving forward.
